spec.situation_desc: sent a bank transfer that arrived days late, so they missed a rent payment

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Hello, Liam at Thistle Bank. How can I help?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Hi, I’m Declan Lindqvist. My bank transfer arrived days late and I missed my rent payment. I’m really unhappy about it.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I can see the £860 transfer from your account ending 4412 was sent on 7 October and reached the other bank on 11 October. What happened?

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: That’s the one. I sent it in time for the rent due date, but it didn’t get there. My landlord charged me a late fee.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Right. I’ll log this as a complaint. I’m sorry it’s taken time to get this sorted.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Can you tell me why it was delayed, and what you’re going to do about it?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll need to look into the transfer records and what caused the delay. I can’t say what the outcome will be.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Okay. I don’t want to have to keep chasing this.

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll take ownership. I’ll review the transfer and the delay, and I’ll call you by Friday 30 October with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: And when will I get a proper response?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Next, I’ll investigate the payment records, then we’ll send you a full written response within 15 business days. I’ll also call you by Friday with an update.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: All right. Will that response cover the late fee as well?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: I’ll include the late fee you’ve mentioned in the complaint for review. I can’t promise any particular outcome.

utterances.speaker: customer
utterances.text: Fine. So you’re looking into the delay and the fee, and you’ll call me by Friday, then send the written response within 15 business days. Is that right?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Yes. That’s right. Does that make sense?

utterances.speaker: agent
utterances.text: Okay. I’ve logged it as a complaint, and I’ll be in touch by Friday.
